native_capability_check.rationale: FontManager supplies native 5x12 glyph data, metrics, caching and transparent glyph drawing. Minimal HBNF code is limited to stable word paging, centering, and a reversible oversized-word fallback; direct drawing avoids the full effect’s motion/fade behavior and preserves the continuously rendered Vibe frame.

decision_rationale.selected_path: Adapt the existing HBNF text overlay to use WLED FontManager font 4 (native 5x12), preserving existing host planner semantics and drawing glyphs over the current Matrix frame. Keep page timing and provisional font presentation unfrozen. Use the pre-existing final-output brightness requirement at Matrix output only.
alternatives_considered: Invoke native WLED 2D Scrolling Text as a full effect
Use FontManager directly with only paging/placement glue
Continue reading WLED PROGMEM bitmaps with a bespoke HBNF raster parser
Recover or recreate external WBF font assets
decision_rationale.challenger_analysis: The full WLED effect is mature but brings vertical motion, trail behavior, and segment/effect routing that do not match the immediate stable-hold HBNF moment contract. Direct WLED FontManager calls reuse native glyph data, width metrics, cache and pixel writes. The previous adapter read WLED font byte tables itself; removing that parser reduces bespoke work. Exact historical WBF assets are not required because the pinned upstream contains a built-in native 5x12 font. The 5x12 appearance remains provisional and unaccepted.
decision_rationale.tradeoffs: Word paging and centering remain minimal HBNF glue; oversized single words use a reversible scroll fallback. The provisional 5x12 font may be changed after owner review without changing shared contracts. Direct FontManager segment cache and ESP32 runtime cost still require target build/runtime evidence before acceptance.
decision_rationale.simplest_robust_solution: Use FontManager’s built-in font 4 and native glyph rendering; retain only word-boundary pagination, centering and the existing 2200 ms hold as provisional implementation details.
decision_rationale.critical_path_reason: This closes offline text/brightness source integration without inventing font assets or an alternate renderer and enables one offline Phase 2 build candidate. It does not authorize live mutation or final visual acceptance.
